notes.title: Notice of Bug Fix (Ver.1.0.2c)
notes.notes:
We have made the following fixes:

・Implemented a fix for the startup black screen caused by system language settings *Implemented in the full version only

・Corrected text typos

・Relaxed the conditions for obtaining certain materials



Based on the valuable opinions and feedback we received, we were able to implement these fixes and adjustments, including measures against the black screen issue.
Thank you very much.



All of us on the development team will continue to pour our love, passion, and cuteness into Kemono Teatime so that more people can enjoy it.
We would be delighted if you could help us spread the circle of Kemono Teatime!

notes.title: Notice of Bug Fix: Unable to Progress Past “NowLoading” on PCs Set to Korean
notes.notes:
We have fixed an issue in Kemono Teatime where the game could not progress past the “NowLoading” screen when played on PCs set to the Korean language.

For users who experienced this issue, we kindly ask you to delete your save data and restart the game.



Save data is stored in the following folder:

C:\\Users\\{UserName}\\AppData\\LocalLow\\フリュー株式会社\\けものティータイム\\save



\[아래 한국어 번역]

『Kemono Teatime』을 한국어로 설정된 PC에서 플레이할 때, “NowLoading” 화면에서 더 이상 진행되지 않는 오류를 수정하였습니다.

해당 증상이 발생한 사용자분들께서는 번거로우시겠지만, 저장 데이터를 삭제하신 뒤 게임을 재실행해 주시기 바랍니다.

저장 데이터는 아래의 폴더에 보관되어 있습니다.

C:\\Users\\{사용자명}\\AppData\\LocalLow\\フリュー株式会社\\けものティータイム\\save

notes.title: Release Commemorative Comment & Illustration
notes.notes:
To celebrate the release of Kemono Teatime, we received a congratulatory comment and illustration from kiri of "VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action".


■ Illustration
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849672/deafd92b320a3d76e73d070a3623339a0535ea1c.png"]

illustration by kiri


■ comment
it has a meaning behind, but i prefer if it's left to interpretation. lately it's hard for me to do anything unless it carries a message, a theme; anything. so i appreciate the game going beyond "moe" to actually say something about the world we live in, and how everyone has a different way of facing adversity.





ーーーー

This comment and illustration were shared by kiri after experiencing Kemono Teatime.

kiri, thank you for the wonderful comment and illustration!

We hope everyone can enjoy the themes and messages of Kemono Teatime.

notes.title: Kemono Teatime – September Release & 60,000 Wishlists Achieved!
notes.notes:
Kemono Teatime – September Release & 60,000 Wishlists Achieved!

Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support of Kemono Teatime.

We are thrilled to announce that the game has surpassed 60,000 wishlists on Steam! Your enthusiasm and anticipation mean the world to us—thank you!

To ensure the highest quality experience, we have decided to move the release date from Spring 2025 to September 2025. We apologize for the delay and appreciate your understanding.

Our team is dedicated to crafting a heartwarming and KAWAII tea time experience. The free demo is still available, so if you haven't tried it yet, please give it a sip!

👉 Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698470/

We hope you'll continue to look forward to Kemono Teatime.


■ Director & Producer Letter

Fuyuki Hayashi

Since the announcement of Kemono Teatime, we've received countless messages from around the world expressing excitement. Surpassing 60,000 wishlists is a milestone that fills us with gratitude.

To further refine this charming world, we've decided to set the release for September 2025. We apologize for the wait.

This game is set in a quaint café visited by kemomimi characters. While it doesn't feature grand adventures or battles, we believe it offers a "quiet and gentle experience" that softly touches the heart

As the second flush lingers in the air, we aim to deliver a moment that gently soothes the soul.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: The demo version is now available for a limited time!
notes.notes:
The demo version of Kemono Teatime is now available!

Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. 

Take this opportunity to immerse yourself in a moment of pure relaxation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345060/

Note: The demo will be available only for a limited time, until January 4, 2025.

"Come back again any time!"
If you like what you see, please wishlist Kemono Teatime and we will deliver the latest updates to you. Until then, please sit back with a nice cup of tea and relax.

■Kemono Teatime Guidelines
